hooks.command: echo '--- C-Mastery Session Start ---'; if [ -f PROGRESS.md ]; then head -5 PROGRESS.md; fi; echo 'Chapters built:'; ls -d chapters/*/README.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; echo '/24'

echo 'Running compilation check...'; failed=0; for f in $(find chapters/ -name '*.c' -not -path '*/solution*' 2>/dev/null | head -20); do gcc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c11 -pedantic -fsyntax-only "$f" 2>&1 || failed=1; done; if [ $failed -eq 1 ]; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "C files have compilation errors — fix before committing"}' >&2; exit 2; fi
echo '{"block": true, "message": "Cannot write to .env files directly"}' >&2; exit 2

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path' | xargs -I{} clang-format -i -style='{BasedOnStyle: LLVM, IndentWidth: 4, ColumnLimit: 100}' {} 2>/dev/null; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path' | xargs -I{} gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -pedantic -fsyntax-only {} 2>&1 | tail -5

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path' | xargs -I{} clang-format -i -style='{BasedOnStyle: LLVM, IndentWidth: 4, ColumnLimit: 100}' {} 2>/dev/null; FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path'); GUARD=$(echo "$FILE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/_/g' | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'); grep -q '#ifndef' "$FILE" || echo "WARNING: Missing header guard in $FILE (expected $GUARD)"

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'if echo {} | grep -q "chapters/.*/README.md"; then grep -c "## Layer" {} | xargs -I@ sh -c "if [ @ -lt 5 ]; then echo WARNING: README {} has only @ of 5 required layers; fi"; fi'
echo 'C file operation failed. Common issues: missing #include, undeclared variable, type mismatch. Run gcc with -Wall -Wextra for details.'

hooks.prompt: Review the teammate's output. Check: 1) Do all .c files have the standard header comment block? 2) Are assembly annotations present (// ASSEMBLY: prefix)? 3) Are memory annotations present (// MEMORY: prefix)? 4) Do exercises have both starter.c and solution.c? Return 'approve' if all checks pass, or specific feedback if not.

hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude/transcripts; cp PROGRESS.md .claude/transcripts/progress-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).md 2>/dev/null; echo 'CRITICAL STATE TO PRESERVE: Current chapter progress in PROGRESS.md, c-style-guide conventions, K&R exercise mapping. Always re-read CLAUDE.md after compaction.'
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs your attention" with title "C-Mastery" sound name "Ping"' 2>/dev/null || echo 'NOTIFICATION: Claude needs input'
osascript -e 'display notification "Task complete" with title "C-Mastery" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null || echo 'TASK COMPLETE'
